about: Size limits of the built UI in bytes, gzip-compressed (scripts/bundle-budget.mjs; npm run budget after npm run build, and in CI).
Measured on 2026-11-11 with the alerting pages (M7, #287): the first page load 236 kB, the English and German catalogs 131 and 145 kB, all files 2.67 MB.

Raised with #287: the language catalogs to 165 kB, since alerting's texts are used in the navigation and on every panel (its badge), so they cannot load with the alerting pages alone, and the German one stood at 99 % of the old 146.5 kB; the total to 2.8 MB for six lazy pages and the rule editor (about 32 kB).

Owner decision of 2026-11-15: the first page load (start) and every single lazy chunk stay hard limits; total may grow per release by a fixed, justified amount; making the whole bundle smaller is M8 work (Performance und Tempo).

chunk is the limit of every lazy route chunk outside the start (languages and the chunks named in chunks have their own): the largest measured on 2026-11-15, DashboardPage at 106,001 bytes, plus about 10 % (117,000).

total raised to 3.0 MB for the rest of M7 (#308): measured 2.80 MB on 2026-11-15 with the warehouse sources, traces, Graphite, Redis, Oracle and ClickHouse native; the remaining 0.7.x pages (share links and snapshots, provisioning, reports, settings, SDKs and app plugins) add lazy pages of their own, about 200 kB at the size of the earlier ones.

Raised with #304: the language catalogs to 170 kB (owner decision of 2026-11-16), since the German one reached 161.3 kB with the texts of the 0.7.5 settings and app plugins after they were shortened; splitting the catalogs per area belongs to M8 (Performance und Tempo).

The texts of sharing and provisioning are not part of the language catalogs: they load with their pages (src/i18n/deferred.ts), as chunks under the chunk limit, so the two areas added about 0.6 kB to each language.
The texts of the report pages load with their pages the same way (#325); only the navigation entry and the two lines of the dashboard menu stay in the language catalogs.

total raised to 3.1 MB with #326 (owner decision of 2026-11-19): measured 3.03 MB with the new on-demand pages (traces, the server settings for CORS, registration and backups, apps); the first page load and the language limits are unchanged.

Raised with #387: the language catalogs to 175 kB (owner decision of 2026-11-23), since the German one reached 166.1 kB with the sidebar texts and the pending M8 pages (handbook, themes, dashboards, administration) add more; splitting the catalogs per area stays M8 work (Performance und Tempo).

total raised to 3.3 MB (owner decision of 2026-11-23): one raise for the M8 graph pages of 0.8.1 (canvas, style rules, layouts, export, map panel, about 3.16 MB measured with all of them) and the built-in handbook (#383); the first page load, the language catalogs and every single chunk are unchanged. Making the whole bundle smaller stays M8 work (Performance und Tempo).

Raised with #417: the language catalogs to 185 kB, since the German one reached 175.6 kB with the step catalog and its nine table steps, and the parity batch merged with it (#415 axes, legend and tooltip, #410 XY chart and Trend, #416, #418, #419 and #421 variables) brings it to about 181 kB; these texts show in the panel editor, Explore and the variable bar, so they cannot load with one page. Splitting the catalogs per area stays M8 work (Performance und Tempo).
Raise a limit only in the pull request that needs it, and say why there.
